definitions.explanation: Creating something new from one's own ideas, without imitating others. Most often seen in the forms {独創的|どくそうてき} (original, creative) and {独創性|どくそうせい} (originality).

examples.japanese: {独創|どくそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{独創|どくそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}けている→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧。

⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{独創|どくそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the art world, originality is sometimes valued more than technique.

notes:
Refers to inventing or creating something from one's own ideas rather than imitating. Most common in the derived forms ⟦{独創的|どくそうてき}→独創的：06242_dokusouteki⟧ (original, creative) and ⟦{独創性|どくそうせい}→独創性：05794_dokusousei⟧ (originality).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独創|どくそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧: to be full of originality
- {独創|どくそう}{性|せい}: originality
- {独創|どくそう}{的|てき}: original; creative

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{創造|そうぞう}→創造：03317_souzou⟧: creation — the act of creating, broader than originality
- ⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧: one's own; unique — emphasizes being distinct from others
